source.text: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to YHWH a new song; sing to YHWH, all the earth.

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a new song; \q sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth.
en.B: Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q All the earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Everyone on earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un cantique nouveau ; \q chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, toute la terre.
fr.B: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau ! \q Terre entière, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Chantez un chant nouveau {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Vous tous qui vivez sur la terre, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !

decisions.reason: Most of this psalm (verses 1b-13a) appears, with small differences, in 1 Chronicles 16:23-33, in the song sung when David brought the ark of God to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: a new song: fresh praise for what God has done
decisions.reason: A new song answers a new act of God (33:3; 40:4; 98:1). Isaiah 42:10 calls the ends of the earth to sing one.

decisions.choice: all the earth: everyone on earth
decisions.reason: The whole earth is called on, that is, all its peoples (verses 3, 7, 10), not Israel only.

decisions.choice: "vous" for the hearers called to praise ("Chantez"), for Psalms 84-104
decisions.reason: The psalm calls the whole earth and every people, so French uses the plural imperative, as it does for any group.

source.text: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to YHWH, bless his name; bear news from day to day [of] his salvation.

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q bear news from day to day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation.
en.B: Raise your song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. \q Day after day announce the good news of how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves.
en.R: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q Tell the good news every day: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves!

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, bénissez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q annoncez de jour en jour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut.
fr.B: Élevez vos chants {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; bénissez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. \q Jour après jour, annoncez la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve.
fr.R: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! \q Chaque jour, dites la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve !

decisions.choice: bless his name: praise God, speak well of him
decisions.reason: To bless (barak) God is to praise him and give him honor; "his name" is God himself as he has made himself known.
The verb (basar) is to bring news, usually good news, as in Isaiah 40:9 and 52:7.
Readable says what blessing God's name means (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Recount among the nations his glory, among all the peoples his wonders.

en.L: Recount among the nations {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q among all the peoples {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders.
en.B: Tell the nations of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q and all the peoples of the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.
en.R: Tell the other nations how great and glorious {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. \q Tell people everywhere about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.

fr.L: Racontez parmi les nations {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q parmi tous les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles.
fr.B: Parlez aux nations de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q et à tous les peuples des merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.
fr.R: Dites aux autres nations combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand et glorieux. \q Dites aux gens de partout les choses extraordinaires qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.

decisions.reason: The word (kavod) is literally weight, and so the greatness and splendor of God that deserves honor.
The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts, such as the rescue from Egypt (Exodus 3:20; 78:4).

source.text: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For great [is] YHWH and to be praised exceedingly; to be feared [is] he above all gods.

en.L: For great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and greatly to be praised; \q to be feared [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} above all gods.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great and worthy of the highest praise; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} must be revered above every god.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} deserves all our praise. \q People should honor and fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} far more than any so-called god.

fr.L: Car grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et très digne de louange ; \q redoutable [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} par-dessus tous les dieux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand et digne des plus hautes louanges ; \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’il faut révérer, plus que tout dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mérite toutes nos louanges. \q Les gens devraient {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craindre bien plus que tous ces prétendus dieux.

decisions.choice: to be feared: to be held in awe
decisions.reason: The form (nora') means one who is to be feared, that is, honored with awe and reverence (47:3).
As in 95:3, the other gods are not real rivals; verse 5 says what they are.
Readable prepares for verse 5, which says these gods are nothing (m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י׀כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: For all [the] gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, but YHWH made [the] heavens.

en.L: For all the gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the heavens.
en.B: For every god the peoples serve is a mere nothing, an idol, \q but it was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made the heavens.
en.R: The gods of the other nations are only idols. They are nothing! \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the sky above us.

fr.L: Car tous les dieux des peuples [sont] des idoles de néant, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait les cieux.
fr.B: Car tous les dieux que servent les peuples ne sont que du vide, des idoles, \q mais c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a fait les cieux.
fr.R: Les dieux des autres nations ne sont que des idoles. Ils ne sont rien ! \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait le ciel au-dessus de nous.

decisions.reason: The word ('elilim) means worthless things and is used for idols. It sounds like the word for gods ('elohim), a play on words: the gods of the peoples are no-gods (Isaiah 2:8; Leviticus 19:4).

decisions.choice: made the heavens: the Creator above the gods
decisions.reason: The nations' gods were made by people; the LORD made the sky, where the nations placed their gods. That is the proof of who is God (115:3-4).

decisions.choice: "des idoles de néant" at Literal, keeping the Hebrew play between ʾelohim (gods) and ʾelilim (nothings)
decisions.reason: French cannot keep the sound play; "idoles de néant" keeps both senses of the Hebrew word, an idol and a thing of no worth.

records.literal_gloss: Splendor and majesty [are] before him; strength and beauty [are] in his sanctuary.

en.L: Splendor and majesty [are] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q strength and beauty [are] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary.
en.B: Splendor and majesty stand in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence; \q strength and beauty fill {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy place.
en.R: Glory and royal greatness surround {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Power and beauty fill the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives.

fr.L: La splendeur et la majesté [sont] devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q la force et la beauté [sont] dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire.
fr.B: La splendeur et la majesté se tiennent en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence ; \q la force et la beauté remplissent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu saint.
fr.R: La gloire et la grandeur royale {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent. \q La puissance et la beauté remplissent le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite.

decisions.choice: splendor and majesty: the glory of a king
decisions.reason: The pair (hod, hadar) is used of a king's splendor (21:6; 45:4). Here they stand before the LORD like attendants at his throne.
The parallel in 1 Chronicles 16:27 reads "strength and joy are in his place"; there the ark had not yet a temple.
Readable says what the sanctuary is: God's holy house.

source.text: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to YHWH, clans of [the] peoples, ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, families of the peoples, \q ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and strength.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} what is due, you families of the nations; \q give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and might.
en.R: Give honor to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you families and nations! \q Say that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is glorious and strong.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, familles des peuples, \q rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et force.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est dû, familles des nations ; \q donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et puissance.
fr.R: Rendez honneur {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous toutes, familles et nations ! \q Dites que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est glorieux et fort.

decisions.reason: The verb (yahav) is simply "give"; giving glory and strength to God is acknowledging that they are his.
Verses 7-9 echo 29:1-2, where the same call is made to the heavenly beings; here it goes out to the families of all the peoples (Genesis 12:3).

source.text: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to YHWH [the] glory of his name; lift up an offering and come into his courts.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q lift up an offering and come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} courts.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves; \q bring a gift and enter {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} courts.
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves. \q Bring a gift to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and come into the courtyards of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez une offrande et entrez dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} parvis.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire que mérite {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez un don et entrez dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} parvis.
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom le mérite. \q Apportez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un don et entrez dans les cours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.

decisions.choice: an offering: a gift or tribute
decisions.reason: The word (minchah) is a gift, the tribute brought to a king (2 Samuel 8:2), and the grain offering of the temple (Leviticus 2:1). The nations come like subjects to their King.

decisions.choice: his courts: the courtyards of the temple
decisions.reason: Worshipers gathered in the open courts around the temple building.
Readable says whose courts these are.

source.text: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bow down to YHWH in [the] adornment of holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

en.L: Bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in [the] splendor of holiness; \q tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all the earth.
en.B: Bow low before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in holy splendor; \q tremble in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence, all the earth.
en.R: Bow down and worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is holy and glorious. \q Everyone on earth, tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Prosternez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans [la] splendeur de la sainteté ; \q tremblez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toute la terre.
fr.B: Inclinez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans une sainte splendeur ; \q tremblez en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence, terre entière.
fr.R: Inclinez-vous et adorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est saint et glorieux. \q Vous tous qui êtes sur la terre, tremblez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !

decisions.choice: the splendor of holiness: God's holy splendor
decisions.reason: The phrase (hadrat qodesh) may describe God's holy splendor, the setting of the worship, or the holy attire of those who worship (as in 29:2; 2 Chronicles 20:21). Literal keeps it open; Readable takes it of God.
The verb (chil) is to writhe or tremble, here in awe before the King.
Readable takes the phrase of God himself (m1).

source.text: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם׀יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף־תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Say among the nations, 'YHWH reigns! Yes, [the] world is established; it will not be shaken. He will judge [the] peoples with uprightness.'

en.L: Say among the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns! \q Indeed, the world is established; it will not be shaken. \q He will judge the peoples with uprightness."
en.B: Tell the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! \q The world stands firm; nothing can make it totter. \q He will judge the peoples fairly."
en.R: Tell all the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! \q He has made the world firm, so it cannot be shaken. \q He will judge all people fairly."

fr.L: Dites parmi les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ! \q Oui, le monde est affermi ; il ne sera pas ébranlé. \q Il jugera les peuples avec droiture. »
fr.B: Dites aux nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! \q Le monde tient ferme ; rien ne peut le faire chanceler. \q Il jugera les peuples avec équité. »
fr.R: Dites à toutes les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! \q Il a rendu le monde solide, et rien ne peut l’ébranler. \q Il jugera tous les peuples de façon juste. »

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken the throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) with the LORD as subject is the cry of Psalms 93, 96, 97 and 99. The same form was shouted when a new king took the throne (2 Samuel 15:10; 2 Kings 9:13), so it may also mean "has become King": the LORD is acclaimed as King over all the earth.
"The world is established; it will not be shaken" repeats 93:1. Because the LORD is King, the world he made holds firm.
The verb (din) is to judge or govern; "uprightness" (mesharim) is what is level and fair. The King's judging means setting things right.
Balanced and Readable say "is King", the plain sense of the royal cry; Literal keeps "reigns".
Readable names who made the world firm, which the passive verb implies.

source.text: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad; let the sea thunder and its fullness.

en.L: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad; \q let the sea thunder, and its fullness.
en.B: Let the heavens be full of joy and the earth be glad; \q let the sea thunder with all that lives in it.
en.R: Let the sky and the earth be happy! \q Let the sea and all the creatures in it roar!

fr.L: Que les cieux se réjouissent et que la terre soit dans l’allégresse ; \q que gronde la mer et ce qui la remplit.
fr.B: Que les cieux soient pleins de joie et la terre en fête ; \q que la mer gronde avec tout ce qui vit en elle.
fr.R: Que le ciel et la terre soient heureux ! \q Que la mer et tous les animaux qui y vivent fassent entendre leur bruit !

decisions.choice: its fullness: all that fills the sea
decisions.reason: The word (melo') is what fills something; here the creatures of the sea (24:1).
The sea is often a picture of chaos and threat (93:3-4); here even the sea thunders in praise of its King. Psalm 98:7 repeats the line.

source.text: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] field exult and all that [is] in it; then all [the] trees of [the] forest will shout for joy

en.L: Let the field exult and all that [is] in it; \q then all the trees of the forest will shout for joy,
en.B: Let the fields and everything in them celebrate; \q then every tree in the woods will cry out with joy,
en.R: Let the fields and everything in them be glad. \q Then all the trees in the forest will sing for joy.

fr.L: Que les champs exultent et tout ce qui [est] en eux ; \q alors tous les arbres de la forêt crieront de joie
fr.B: Que les champs et tout ce qu’ils portent soient dans la joie ; \q alors tous les arbres des bois crieront de joie
fr.R: Que les champs et tout ce qui s’y trouve soient joyeux. \q Alors tous les arbres de la forêt chanteront de joie.

decisions.choice: the trees shout for joy: creation welcomes its King
decisions.reason: The poem pictures the whole creation, sky, sea, fields and forest, celebrating the King's coming, as in Isaiah 55:12.
"Then" points to the moment named in verse 13, when the LORD comes to judge.
"Before the LORD" in verse 13 completes this line, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: before YHWH, for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge [the] world with righteousness and [the] peoples with his faithfulness.

en.L: before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes to judge the earth. \q He will judge the world with righteousness \q and the peoples with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness.
en.B: in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is on the way, on the way to judge the earth. \q He will bring justice to the world \q and judge its peoples by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own faithfulness.
en.R: They will sing in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming. He is coming to rule the earth as judge. \q He will judge the world with justice \q and treat all peoples with faithfulness.

fr.L: devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient juger la terre. \q Il jugera le monde avec justice \q et les peuples selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité.
fr.B: devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en chemin, en chemin pour juger la terre. \q Il fera justice au monde \q et jugera ses peuples selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre fidélité.
fr.R: Ils chanteront devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient. Il vient gouverner la terre comme juge. \q Il jugera le monde avec justice \q et traitera tous les peuples avec fidélité.

decisions.choice: judge: rule and set things right
decisions.reason: The verb (shafat) means more than passing sentence: it is to govern and to put wrongs right. For a world under wrong, the coming of this Judge is good news, and creation sings.

decisions.choice: for he comes, for he comes: repeated for emphasis
decisions.reason: The repetition makes the arrival urgent and near. The form can mean "he has come" or "he is coming"; the joy of verses 11-12 looks forward to it.
Psalm 98:9 ends with almost the same words; the parallel in 1 Chronicles 16:33 stops after "to judge the earth".
Readable ended verse 12 with a full stop, so it repeats the subject: the trees sing before the LORD.
